description: This file defines the DataGroupPermission entity class for a Human Resource Management System, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping. It includes properties for permissions such as read, create, update, delete, and self, along with relations to DataGroup and UserRole entities, and corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: DataGroupPermission
classes.description: Entity class representing permissions associated with a data group and user role, with fields indicating allowed actions and relationships to DataGroup and UserRole entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the permission record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the permission record.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Checks if create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Checks if update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Checks if delete permission is granted.

methods.name: setDataGroup
methods.description: Associates a DataGroup entity with this permission.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Associates a UserRole entity with this permission.
